meta.name: paid-ads-linkedin
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, plan, and safely operate connected LinkedIn Ads accounts through the NotFair MCP, with an export-based fallback. Use for LinkedIn advertising, sponsored content, lead-generation forms, job-title or company targeting, campaign groups, creatives, conversions, lead quality, budgets, bids, or approved LinkedIn campaign changes.

copy.tagline: 审计并优化领英广告账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在领英投放广告并想优化效果
copy.tagline_en: Audit and optimize LinkedIn ad accounts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run LinkedIn ads and need to improve performance

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 通过 NotFair 连接或导出文件审计、诊断和规划 LinkedIn 广告账户。它会读取广告系列、创意和转化数据，报告支出、潜客等指标，并在用户批准后安全执行预算、出价等变更。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 LinkedIn 广告、赞助内容、潜客表单、定位等，或请求修改预算、出价等已批准变更时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个 LinkedIn 广告账户最近30天的表现。
say.note: Claude 会读取数据并生成报告。

say.text: 诊断针对市场部经理职位的广告系列表现。
say.note: Claude 检查定位并给出假设。

say.text: 把这些广告系列的预算提高10%，先做干运行预览。
say.note: Claude 先展示预期效果再应用。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude audit, diagnose, plan, and safely operate LinkedIn Ads accounts through the NotFair MCP or an export fallback. It reads campaign, creative, and conversion data, reports metrics like spend and leads, and executes approved budget and bid changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions LinkedIn advertising, sponsored content, lead-gen forms, targeting, etc., or asks for approved changes to budgets, bids, or campaign settings.

say_en.text: Audit this LinkedIn Ads account for the last 30 days.
say_en.note: Claude reads data and returns a report.

say_en.text: Diagnose the campaign targeting marketing manager roles.
say_en.note: Claude reviews targeting and suggests hypotheses.

say_en.text: Increase these campaigns' budgets by 10% with a dry-run preview.
say_en.note: Claude shows expected effect before applying.
